projects.title: Ball Collision Decoding Performance on Linear Codes (Master's Thesis)
projects.description:
• Conducted research on the McEliece cryptosystem (post-quantum code-based encryption scheme)
• Employed information-set decoding concepts to implement new fastest decoding attack
• Wrote attack using MAGMA, tested on codes up to n=1600 bits in length
• Performed complexity analysis as code length n goes to infinity, showed Ball Collision attack is asymptotically
superior to previous best attack

projects.title: LZW Compression
projects.description:
• Implemented the LZW lossless compression algorithm in C++
• Dynamically re-constructs discarded dictionaries during decompression to properly retrieve message
• Achieved compression ratios as large as 2:1 for larger files
